notes.train_window_candles: Walk-forward training/context window length per fold.
notes.step_candles: How far the window advances each fold (non-overlapping if == test_window).
notes.warmup_candles: Candles required before the first decision so indicators + Kronos context are valid.
notes.decision_frequency_candles: Evaluate signals every N candles inside the test window.
notes.use_cached_forecasts: Reuse forecasts already stored for the exact (symbol, tf, context_end, config_hash). Never reuse a forecast whose context extends past decision time.
